run_flux_dreambooth_lora_training: run FLUX LoRA DreamBooth training on HPU using a custom image dataset and pretrained model
configure_training_arguments: configure training hyperparameters like learning rate, batch size, and resolution via argparse CLI
create_dreambooth_dataset: create a DreamBoothDataset that computes T5 text embeddings and applies image transformations for training
pack_latents_for_flux: pack latents by reshaping and permuting dimensions for FLUX transformer input
unpack_latents_from_flux: unpack latents from FLUX transformer output back to the original spatial shape
